_comment: Per-collection overrides for scripts/skill_graph.py, keyed by collection uuid
or by exact collection title. Keys: "date" (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM) to place
the event on the chronological axis, "label" to shorten the x-axis caption,
"include": false to keep a collection off the chart.
Without a "date", an event is dated from its title: a four-digit year (or a
'YY) plus a month name if one is present. That is enough to order events
across years, but events sharing a year fall back to alphabetical order, so
give any year with more than one event explicit dates.
